tool_args.rationale: The pilot exhibits history dependence and coupled lag, consistent with the recalled two-state memory mechanism. The additional trajectory batch supplies observations needed to fit and distinguish its four parameters before fresh confirmation.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the coupled two-state memory ODE to the five pilot rows
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: Five forecast observations leave the four coupled parameters and their predictive generalization insufficiently identified.
The recalled mechanism identifies the extra-fine trajectory batch as the probe needed to constrain the coupled memory model.
These one-state alternatives do not account for the observed history dependence and coupled transient lag.
